noun_definition: web refers to the online interface where users can split bills and view participant information, such as display names, in a tooltip.
Tooltip refers to the informational text that appears when hovering over the counter in the split preview, which is expected to display the participants' display names.

email refers to the identifier used for participants in the split bill feature, which is expected to be displayed in the tooltip instead of their display names when hovering over the counter in the split preview.
Display name refers to the name assigned to participants in a split bill that is expected to be displayed in the tooltip when hovering over the counter in the split preview.
Counter refers to the visual element in the split preview that indicates the number of participants involved in the bill-splitting process.

Split preview refers to the interface element that displays the breakdown of a bill among multiple participants, where users can hover over a counter to see additional information about each participant.
